items.Sentence: The existing OWTS at the South Entrance Station consists of flush toilets at the 'Ranger office' and the 'Historic Comfort Station'. The septic tanks at the existing areas will be replaced.

The new septic tanks at the Historic Comfort Center and the Ranger office will have capacities of 15,000 gallons and 2,000 gallons, respectively. The septic tank for the new Visitor Contact Center will have a 55,000 gallon capacity.
New 6-inch PVC pipe will convey effluent from all three new septic tanks to a 20,000 gallon dosing tank for flow equalization.

The effluent will be discharged from the dosing tank into a new 3-acre leachfield southwest of the South Entrance Station...consisting of a pressure distribution leach trench constructed in four cells.
